notes:
# v1.4.17 - keep reading when the sync server is down

- Fixed: if the sync server cannot be reached and you are not signed in, the app
  used to show the full-screen sign-in screen with no way past it, so the reader
  could not be used at all. It now explains that the sync server is unreachable
  and offers "Continue without an account", so you can dismiss the screen and
  keep reading.
- Fixed: dismissing that screen also hides it for the rest of the session, so it
  no longer reappears on every refresh while the server is still down.
- Note: no action needed - just update. Your library, bookmarks and reading
  progress stay on the device either way, and syncing resumes by itself once the
  sync server is reachable again.
